entries.title: I Corinthians 15:1
segments: Now I am calling to your remembrance, brothers, the gospel which I preached to you, which you also received, and on which you have taken your stand,

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:2
segments: by which also you are saved, if you are holding fast the message which I preached to you; unless indeed you have believed in vain.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:3
segments: For the very first thing I taught you was that I had myself been taught, that Christ died for our sins according to the Scripture,

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:4
segments: that he was buried, and that he was raised the third day, according to the Scriptures,

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:5
segments: and was seen by Cephas, and then by the Twelve.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:6
segments: Afterward he was seen at one time by more than five hundred brethren, most of whom are still alive, but some are fallen asleep.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:7
segments: Then he was seen by James, then by all the apostles,

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:8
segments: and last of all, as by one born out of due time, he was seen by me also.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:9
segments: For I am the least of the apostles, I who am not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:10
segments: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and that grace of his, bestowed upon me, did not prove ineffectual. I labored more abundantly than all the rest, yet not I, but by the grace of God that is with me.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:11
segments: But whether it is I or they, thus do I preach, and thus you came to believe.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:12
segments: If then, we are preaching Christ, that he rose from the dead, how are some of you saying that there is no resurrection from the dead?

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:13
segments: But if there is no resurrection from the dead, then not even Christ has been raised;

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:14
segments: and if Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is vain, and vain also is your faith.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:15
segments: More than that, we are detected in bearing false witness against God; because we testified of God that he raised Christ from the dead, whom he did not raise, if indeed the dead rise not.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:16
segments: For if the dead rise not, neither has Christ arisen;

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:17
segments: and if Christ be not risen, your faith is vain, you are still in your sins.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:18
segments: More than that, those who are sleeping in Christ have perished.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:19
segments: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all mankind most pitiable.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:20
segments: But now, now, Christ is risen from the dead, the first-fruit of those who have fallen asleep.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:21
segments: For since by man came to death, by man came also the resurrection from the dead.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:22
segments: For just as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:23
segments: But each in his own order; Christ the first-fruits, then those who belong to Christ at his appearing.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:24
segments: And then the end, when he shall hand over his kingdom to God his Father, after he has abolished all rule and authority and power.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:25
segments: For he must rule until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:26
segments: The last enemy that will be destroyed is Death.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:27
segments: For He hast put all things under his feet, but in that quotation All things are put under him, it is evident that God is excepted, who put all things under Him.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:28
segments: For when everything is subjected to him, then the Son himself shall subject himself to Him who made them subject, that God may be all in all.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:29
segments: Else what shall they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are really not raised, why are they baptized for them?

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:30
segments: Yes, and why am I myself exposed to danger every hour?

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:31
segments: Every day I am facing death, my brothers, I affirm it by that pride in you which I have through Christ Jesus our Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:32
segments: If after the manner of men I have fought with wild beasts at Ephesus, what good does it do me? If the dead do not rise, Let us eat and drink, For we shall be dead tomorrow.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:33
segments: Do not deceive yourselves: Evil companions ruin good morals.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:34
segments: Wake up, do justly, cease from sin; for I say to your shame that some of you have no acquaintance with God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:35
segments: But some one will ask: "How are the dead raised? and with what body are they coming?"

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:36
segments: Foolish man! The seed you sow does not come to life unless it dies.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:37
segments: And when you sow the seed you are not sowing the body that it will become, but bare grain, of wheat perhaps, or some other grain.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:38
segments: But God gives it what body he pleases, and to each kind of seed its own body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:39
segments: All flesh is not the same flesh; there is human flesh, another of fishes of animals, another of birds, another of fishes.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:40
segments: There are both celestial bodies and bodies terrestrial; but the splendor of the celestial is one thing, and the splendor of the terrestrial is another.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:41
segments: There is one glory of the sun, another of the moon, and another of the stars; for star differs from star in glory.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:42
segments: So it is in the resurrection of the dead: It is sown in corruption, It is raised in incorruption;

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:43
segments: Sown in weakness, It is raised in power;

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:44
segments: The body sown is animal The body is raised is spiritual. If there is an animal body, there is also a spiritual body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:45
segments: Thus it is written: The first man, Adam, became a living being, the last Adam, a life-giving Spirit.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:46
segments: Now it is not the spiritual which is first, but the animal, and then the spiritual.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:47
segments: The first man is of the earth, earthly; the second Man is of heaven.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:48
segments: Like him who was of earth, are the earthy; and like Him who is of heaven, are the heavenly;

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:49
segments: As we have borne the likeness of him who was of earth, so also let us bear the likeness of Him who is of heaven.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:50
segments: I tell you this, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; nor can corruption inherit incorruption.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:51
segments: Lo, I tell you a secret truth: we shall not all be sleeping, but we shall be changed,

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:52
segments: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, when the last trumpet sounds. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised, incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:53
segments: For this corruptible must be clothed with incorruption, and this mortal must be clothed with immortality.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:54
segments: And when this mortal has been clothed with immortality, then will the words of Scripture come to pass, Death has been swallowed up in victory.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:55
segments: Where, Death, is thy victory? Where, Death, is thy sting?

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:56
segments: Now the sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the Law.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:57
segments: But thanks be to God, who has given us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 15:58
segments: So, my brothers beloved, stand firm, immovable, always abounding in work for the Lord, because you know that your toil is not fruitless in the Lord.
